description: Software Factory inspector for the GitHub Copilot CLI: audits each job when it ends (close, cancel or abandon — from the agent, a chat reply or your terminal), reports on session start, applies your finding replies, and keeps its own controls human-only.

sessionStart.powershell: $r = if ($env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT } else { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not (Test-Path "$r/hooks/session-start.js")) { exit 0 }; node "$r/hooks/session-start.js" sessionStart; exit $LASTEXITCODE

userPromptSubmitted.powershell: $r = if ($env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT } else { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not (Test-Path "$r/hooks/prompt.js")) { exit 0 }; node "$r/hooks/prompt.js" userPromptSubmitted; exit $LASTEXITCODE

preToolUse.powershell: $r = if ($env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT } else { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not (Test-Path "$r/hooks/guard.js")) { exit 0 }; node "$r/hooks/guard.js" preToolUse; exit $LASTEXITCODE

postToolUse.powershell: $r = if ($env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT } else { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not (Test-Path "$r/hooks/after-close.js")) { exit 0 }; node "$r/hooks/after-close.js" postToolUse; exit $LASTEXITCODE

agentStop.powershell: $r = if ($env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT } else { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not (Test-Path "$r/hooks/catch-up.js")) { exit 0 }; node "$r/hooks/catch-up.js" agentStop; exit $LASTEXITCODE
